newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PEDROS JOINS PARMA FROM MARSEILLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PEDROS JOINS PARMA FROM MARSEILLE.

text.p: France's Reynald Pedros, unimpressive this season with Marseille, joined Italian club Parma on Tuesday.
Officials said that the 24-year-old international playmaker and striker had signed until the year 2000. He will be presented officially on Wednesday.
After signing, he immediately began training with his new team mates.
The club gave no details of the sum involved but sources said Marseille would get around $3.6 million.
Pedros, a gifted but moody player, joined Marseille from Nantes at the start of the season.
He is expected to replace of 31-year-old midfielder Massimo Crippa, likely to leave at the end of the season.
